method: Read-only NOS configuration/process inspection and offline AArch64 disassembly. No service calls, process changes, or motion commands.
facts: NOS local_planner.sh enables pcl_pass_grid + localPlanner. Its alternative pcl_remove command is commented out and explicitly labelled passability input /impassable_area.
pcl_remove binary contains input /impassable_area and output /NAV_POINTS.

NOS passable_area is running. nav_params.yaml defines an 8x8 m, .05 m elevation region and separate traversability-cost parameters; cost step_free=.08, step_block=.35, step_weight=.4, slope_weight=.3, roughness_weight=.3.
Handler input /HANDLE_STEER callback reads x/y/yaw into ProcessVel; separate handler obstacle input is /cloud_nav and output /NAV_CMD.
Handler::SetOoaParamCallback 0x9bfb0 reads StairOA and stores desired state at object+0x55.

Handler::CheckStairOaEnabledState 0x9c140 compares desired/current flags, converts desired flag to StdSrvInt32.command 0/1 at 0x9c250-0x9c260, and calls client at 0x9c284. Client service name is /HEIGHT_MAP_STAIR_OA_ENABLE.
These functions establish a stair obstacle-avoidance switch, not a demonstrated gait switch or stair-climbing controller.
limits: Did not recover /HEIGHT_MAP_STAIR_OA_ENABLE server implementation. Enabled/disabled effect on stair classification and its deployment host remain unverified.
Traversal cost thresholds are software configuration, not guaranteed robot physical stair-height limits.
Did not establish auto stair detection -> gait switching -> foothold control or autonomous stair execution.
Copied default native integration includes pcl_pass_grid and localPlanner only; it does not add passable_area/pcl_remove/handler stair service.
update_20261014: AOS height_map_nav server and basic_server saved-task gait/parameter chain recovered. Earlier missing-server limitation is superseded; complete height-map preprocessing and cross-map task execution remain incomplete.
